g.text: Sequence Diagram - VIS07 Camera Lifecycle (reload, configuration switch, leaving the page)
Every path that replaces or leaves the scene goes through ViewerEngine.dispose()
(VIS01 sequence_diagram_viewer_lifecycle). Modules are disposed in reverse order,
so the camera module (built last) is disposed first.
1. Reload or switch of the active configuration
Reload (or a new configuration is activated in WEB06)
The new attempt creates a NEW module and controller:
limits and initial view are recomputed from the new
dimensions, assembly-line wall and current aspect
Reload / leaves while the scene is still building
dispose() (camera module may not be built yet)
abort build; dispose other modules and resources
no scene started for the aborted attempt
build() returns immediately when ctx.signal is aborted
or the module is already disposed, so no CameraController
and no OrbitControls are created for an aborted attempt.
